title: Stakeout
caption: 1960s crime jazz instrumental, tense and stylish. A prowling upright bass ostinato, bongos and brushed snare, tremolo electric guitar, vibraphone, flute lead, muted brass stabs that build suspense. Detective television theme mood, watching a doorway from a parked car. Warm vintage analog recording. No vocals.
note: Preferred in the listening test (configuration B).
